content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a good week. Thank you for sending over the contract. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before I sign. Specifically, regarding the relevant clause stating: 'EXCEPT FOR CLAIMS UNDER SECTION 9 HEREOF, THE LIABILITY OF A PARTY TO THE OTHER FOR DIRECT DAMAGES SHALL NOT EXCEED FIFTEEN MILLION DOLLARS.' - Claims under Section 9, which include intellectual property indemnification and warranties, are completely excluded from the liability cap, exposing you to unlimited financial risk for those claims. To address this, I suggest we modify this so that: 'The liability of a party to the other for direct damages under this Agreement shall not exceed Fifteen Million Dollars in the aggregate.' Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
